5. **Marketing Campaign Brief**: Alex Johnson from Innovative Toys Inc. requests a marketing campaign proposal for a new 'Space Explorer' toy line targeting children aged 6-12.
6. **Investment Confirmation**: An email from Investor Relations asks the recipient to reply 'confirmation' to contact@contact.com to accept an investment proposal.
7. **Speaking Invitation**: Melissa Carter from TechCon invites Casey to speak on a marketing panel at TechCon on May 15th.
8. **AdWords Analysis Request**: Rachel Kim from Digital AdWorks asks Casey to analyze the performance of a health and wellness AdWords campaign that is underperforming.
9. **Content Marketing Strategy**: Linda Nguyen from Fresh Organic Produce requests a content marketing strategy for a new blog focused on organic eating and sustainable living.
